method: Apple public search (fetch_reviews.py search) and public customer-review RSS (fetch_reviews.py reviews, rating <= 3, most recent, 3 pages). Raw review text saved under state/scout/reviews/<app id>.json. No WebFetch, no Reddit, no logins. Quotes are verbatim substrings of the saved review text.

candidates.unmet_job: Keep a private journal or mood log that stays on the device, with no AI features, no forced account and an app lock.

complaints.quote: I noticed the little star thing that indicates an AI feature. AI. In a journaling app.
Ai is pushy pushy.. I am done
there’s no way to turn it off. It’s always sitting there, waiting for you to accidentally hit it.
I don’t care about AI and I don’t want to be constantly pestered to ‘upgrade’ to the Gold plan.
So having AI prompt me questions based off of my habits is very scary. How much of my data is being shared?
The AI features made me uncomfortable … you’re sharing your private thoughts with an AI bot. No thank you!
I could find no way to lock or password protect the Stoic app.
There is absolutely no point in moving the app off of device storage and into the cloud other than data harvesting

candidates.not_found: No keyword volume or difficulty source available. Did not read reviews for 4-5 star users of these apps, so the size of the no-AI group against the AI-liking group is unknown (some Day One reviewers in the same window praise the AI chat).
candidates.notes: Shares an app type with lifestyle-j2 (journal). Reported as a fact for the caller; no judgement made.

candidates.unmet_job: Share a calendar between two people so it stays identical on both phones, handles time zones, and stays in two-way sync with Apple Calendar and Reminders or exports out.

complaints.quote: The person I share my calendar with suddenly sees a completely blank calendar, even though all the appointments are still visible on my end.
when the two people sharing a calendar are in different time zones—for example, when one person is in another country—the app does not properly synchronize appointment times between them.
This calendar app constantly unsyncs itself and my wife and I have to manually update almost daily to ensure our calendars match.
My entire calendar was randomly wiped out one day!
Why can’t I export this calendar to something like Google Calendar??
TimeTree can’t be exported to Google Calendar despite having seamless importing.
this app won’t move or delete old events to match iPhone or iPad.
especially true two-way editing with Apple Calendar and Apple Reminders so events and shared tasks can be managed from either app.
she appeared to be connected, but she could not access the calendar.

candidates.not_found: Only two apps read. Howbout, Teamup and Google Calendar appeared in search but their reviews were not read. A shared calendar needs a second user and a backend, which the caller prefers to avoid; this is noted as a fact, not a judgement.
candidates.notes: Price and ad complaints on these apps were present and are excluded from this candidate.

candidates.not_found: Only three 2026 complaints with the specific job. ElephantTrax reviews are mostly 2021 to 2024. ElephantTrax and SnapFind sell physical labels or have QR tie-ins; the unmet job here is the app side only. SmartLabels (1555535491) returned 1 review and was not used.
